heading: Could Connor Hellebuyck’s trade demand force the Winnipeg Jets into a major decision before NHL season starts
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 19:15 IST
paragraphs: It’s unclear what the future holds for Connor Hellebuyck with the Winnipeg Jets after the three-time Vezina Trophy winner publicly asked for a trade in August
Things got worse when he didn't show up for training camp and the Jets suspended him.The 33-year-old goaltender made his stance known after making a private request for a move months ago

But Hellebuyck said he felt moving on was the best course of action for himself and his family, and Winnipeg has continued to explore its options.What does Connor Hellebuyck want from Winnipeg Jets?Connor Hellebuyck has asked the Winnipeg Jets to assist in facilitating a trade, but the team has not said where his preferred destination is

Team GM Kevin Cheveldayoff said the team is still looking for a solution that works for both sides.Hellebuyck has made public the decision about his future and family, but has not gone into detail on all of the factors behind the request
He said his position had not changed and moving on was the best path forward in a statement.The development comes after a tough 2025-26 season for Winnipeg

The Jets missed the Stanley Cup Playoffs after winning the Presidents’ Trophy last season, and Hellebuyck posted a 2.86 goals-against average and .895 save percentage in 57 games.What happened after Connor Hellebuyck missed camp?Hellebuyck was suspended by the organization after not reporting to Winnipeg Jets training camp on Sept. 16

The move comes in an already uneasy trade landscape as Winnipeg prepares for the 2026-27 NHL season.Cheveldayoff has said the Jets aren’t going to just move Hellebuyck without getting the right value in return
The goaltender still has five years left on his seven-year, $8.5 million average annual value deal.The Jets are in season preparation mode, and Cheveldayoff is working toward a potential resolution

Captain Adam Lowry had previously asked teammates to focus on preparing for the season, not have trade speculation take over the locker room.The organization also added Stuart Skinner, giving the Jets a veteran option in net while Hellebuyck remains away from the team

For now, the trade request is still pending, and the Jets are left with a major roster decision to make while trying to prepare for the NHL season ahead.The trade request of Connor Hellebuyck has become one of the biggest storylines in the NHL as the Winnipeg Jets seek a potential resolution; and the three-time Vezina Trophy winner did not report to training camp and was later suspended by the team.Hellebuyck has said that moving on is what is best for himself and his family, while Jets general manager Kevin Cheveldayoff continues to explore trade options
Winnipeg has also added goaltender Stuart Skinner, giving them another option while Hellebuyck is out
